_comment: Page manifest. build.py renders one output file per entry, and sitemap.xml is generated from this list. Adding the future per-exam product pages means appending entries here (one per pack, data_file pointing at a generated json derived from that pack's website.json) plus one new template. No change to build.py is required for that, which is the whole point of the manifest. The privacy and support pages share templates/document.html, so a further policy page is an entry here plus a block in site.json and no new template at all.
